title: Guidewire Digital-Staff
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Job purpose:**
 Technical Lead in the IT Consulting Services team to work on various Guidewire implementation projects with Portal and EDGE implementation for our customers across the globe.
   

  

**Your client responsibilities:**
* Need to work as a team leader (technical leader) to contribute in various technical streams of Guidewire implementation project.
* Interface and communicate with the onsite coordinators
* Planning and monitoring of the project deliverables from the team.
* Mentor the project team in executing the identified projects
* Regular status reporting to the Manager and onsite coordinators
* Interface with the customer representatives as and when needed
* Willing to travel to the customers locations on need basis
* Should be able to handle demanding clients and handle the deliveries


**Your people responsibilities** 
 :
 **\- as a team leader you will:**
* Building a quality culture
* Manage the performance management for the direct reporters, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization\-wide people initiatives


**We are looking for the candidates with the following:** 
 BE/BTech/MCA with a sound industry experience of 7 to 10 Yrs
   

  

**You will need to have:(GW Portal and EDGE Competencies, AngularJS, ReactJS)**
**Mandatory skills:**
* Java 8\+, JSON, REST API, ReactJS/AngularJS, Javascript, HTML.
* Should have strong knowledge and experience on Tomcat and or Websphere/Weblogic
* Real time knowledge and experience on enterprise system integration, Preferably from Insurance domain background.
* Should have understanding and experience of software development best practices.
* Excellent business communication skills.
* Excellent leadership skills.
* Experience in Guidewire Portals.
* Experience in Insurance domain, preferably in Property \& Casualty.


**Experience preferred:** 
 REST API, ReactJS/AngularJS, Core java, Gosu \& Insurance sector domain experience.
   

  

**Good to Have:** 
 Git repository, Guidewire Certified is an added advantage, Template Design Pattern.
   

  

**Preferred Skills:**
* Experience in GuideWire, Policy Center Configuration/ Integration/Conversion
* Experience in Insurance domain, preferably in Property \& Casualty.
* Prior Client facing experience


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Java Module Lead
description:
*Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.*




*The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.*




*In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.*




*In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.*



**Job Description**

  

  





**Module Lead – Java**




**Eurofins IT Solutions, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India**
  

  

  

 With facilities in Europe, the United States, and Asia, Eurofins Genomics is an internationally leading provider of DNA sequencing services, genotyping services, DNA synthesis products, and bioinformatics services for pharmaceutical, diagnostics, food, agriculture, biotechnology, and research markets.
   

  

  

  

 The Genomics business is powered by global engineering teams building next\-generation applications, LIMS platforms, and enterprise systems. As a Tech Lead – Java, you will play a hands\-on leadership role in designing, developing, and modernizing scalable, high\-performance platforms.
   

  

  

  

 You will drive solution design, architecture decisions, and technical direction, while ensuring delivery excellence. The role requires close collaboration with engineering, architecture, DevOps, QA, and product teams to deliver robust, secure, and reliable solutions aligned with business goals.
   

  

  

  

 This role reports to a Project Manager / Senior Manager.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**



* Lead end\-to\-end technical design and development of enterprise\-scale Java applications
* Own solution architecture for modules/domains, ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability
* Drive modernization initiatives (monolith to microservices, cloud adoption)
* Define and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and best practices
* Review architecture, code, and design to ensure quality and maintainability
* Mentor and guide engineers, fostering strong technical capability within teams
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex issues and production challenges



**Required Skills**



* Strong hands\-on experience with:
* Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Microservices and distributed system design
* Angular / React (working knowledge)
* SQL Server, MongoDBStrong understanding of design patterns, OOP, and scalable architectures
* Experience with performance tuning, JVM optimization, and system reliability
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD, Docker, and cloud platforms
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and messaging systems
* Exposure to cloud\-native design and container orchestration (e.g., AKS/Kubernetes)
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, monitoring, and observability tools
* Experience in domain\-driven design or enterprise integration patterns



**Experience**



* 10–15 years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based development
* Proven experience as a Technical Lead in enterprise systems
* Strong experience in product development and modernization programs
* Solid understanding of Agile / Scrum methodologies



**Tech Stack**



* Frontend: Angular, React
* Backend: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs
* Databases: SQL Server, MongoDB
* Cloud \& DevOps: Azure, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes (optional)
* Quality: JUnit, Mockito, SonarQube



******Additional Information******




**Required Qualifications:**
  

 Bachelors in Engineering or Masters in Computer Science or equivalent
   

  

  

  

**Personal Skills:**



* Customer\-service oriented with a problem\-solving attitude;
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
* Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
* Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
* Structured and clear writing skills;
* Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
* Demonstrated positive attitude, self\-motivated, team player.



****Additional Information****




**Just some of the benefits we offer are:**



* Gym membership
* Company pension scheme
* •24/7 Employee Assistance programme (Offering Legal, Financial, Medical advice and counselling), and many more



**The Location:**




 Eurofins Digital Testing offices are based in Bristol City Centre. We are right next to Cabot Circus and many bars and restaurants. Our office is easy to commute to and has fantastic views over the city centre too. This area is a great place to live and work, with lots going on.
   

  





**Why Should You Apply?**



* Competitive pay with a well\-established and growing international company.
* Good benefits and flexible working opportunities.
* Great location within the city centre.
* Opportunities to progress and grow with the company.
* Occasional opportunities to travel and work around the UK and internationally.



**Start date: ASAP**




 Interview process: Telephone interview followed by an online coding test and if selected, final stage is a face to face interview
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* MCA or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in Java\-based software development on global or enterprise projects.
* Proven experience in product development environments.
* Strong understanding of the Product Development Lifecycle and Lean Agile / Scrum methodologies.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong learning mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

title: Technical Lead
description:
This is a hands\-on engineering role. You will write
 **production code every day** 
 , and you will lead by building the hardest parts yourself.
 



 It is
 **not a management role** 
 . There is no team to administer, no appraisal cycle, no delivery meetings in place of engineering. If you have moved away from daily coding, this role will not suit you.
 



  





**Our Primary tech stack:** 



* React
* React Native
* Python
* Salesforce
* Cloud\-native, across all major clouds
* An agentic layer running through all of it
* Whatever else the client needs



  





**What you will own:** 



* **The build.** 
 Production code every week, on the parts that matter most. Design, write, review, ship.
* **Agentic systems.** 
 LLM\-driven features running in production for clients. Agents, tool calling, retrieval, evaluation, and the cost and latency behind each choice.
* **The technical standard.** 
 Design and code reviews for two or three engineers working alongside you.
* **Delivery.** 
 Scope, estimate, sequence and commitment date. When a date is at risk you raise it before it moves.
* **Technical discussions with clients.** 
 Requirements, trade\-offs, and what is possible by when.



  





**Requirements:** 



* 6–8 years in software engineering, hands\-on throughout
* Python, with production depth
* React, and React Native for mobile
* Cloud in production on AWS, Azure or GCP, deployed and operated by you
* Production code written in the last 90 days
* An LLM or agent feature you have built and shipped to production
* Experience leading engineers technically, through reviews, standards and design decisions
* Delivery ownership: you have carried a date and answered for it
* Able to work hybrid from Coimbatore



  





**Preferred:** 



* Both startup and large\-organisation experience
* Daily use of AI engineering tools such as Claude, Cursor or Copilot, with a clear view of where they help and where they mislead
* You follow the field closely and form views by building with new models and tooling rather than reading about them
* Salesforce
* Client\-facing experience, in India or abroad



  





**Process:** 




 Screening call, technical discussion, delivery and leadership conversation, offer. We aim to close within two weeks of first contact.

title: Lead Quality Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**
 Lead the testing and quality assurance workstream for an AIDriven Development Lifecycle DLC Proof of Concept POC ensuring the quality reliability and effectiveness of AI powered capabilities across the software development lifecycle Drive end to end validation of AI assisted requirements analysis test case generation code generation test automation defect prediction and quality engineering processes Collaborate with business stakeholders development teams QA teams architects and
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Primary Skills
   

  

 Strong experience in Software Testing and Quality Engineering including Functional Testing Automation Testing API Testing Test Strategy Test Management and Quality Governance.
   

  

 Proven experience leading AI GenAI Testing Initiatives including AI\-generated Test Case Validation AI\-assisted Code and Requirement Validation Prompt Testing Model Output Verification Test Coverage Assessment and AI Outcome Quality Measurement.
   

  

 Strong Test Management and Governance skills including test strategy development stakeholder management defect governance risk management readiness reporting KPI tracking and cross\-functional coordination with Development QA Product and AI/ML teams.
   

  

 Secondary Skills
   

  

 Experience with GenAI\-enabled Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) solutions AI testing frameworks and prompt engineering.
   

  

 Knowledge of Playwright Selenium API Testing CI/CD DevOps GitHub Copilot Azure OpenAI and AI\-assisted development tools.
   

  

 Experience with Python automation framework design test orchestration and quality engineering practices.
   

  

 Understanding of LLM validation AI model evaluation AI governance and responsible AI practices.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Healthcare payer/provider domain experience preferred.
   

  

* Possess a strong background in quality engineering with eight to twelve years of experience in designing automating and executing tests for complex enterprise applications.
* Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Python for building automation frameworks utilities and reusable libraries that improve test reliability and reduce maintenance effort.
* Exhibit hands on expertise with Playwright including authoring robust end to end tests managing test fixtures and optimizing suites for stability and speed.
* Show practical experience using Azure services for hosting test environments managing build and release pipelines and integrating automated quality checks within the delivery workflow.
* Display strong working knowledge of GitHub and GitHub Copilot to manage repositories enforce branching strategies and accelerate high quality test development.
* Bring exposure to pharmacy claims or related healthcare domains as a desirable qualification enabling deeper understanding of domain specific validation needs and compliance constraints.
* Communicate clearly with cross functional teams document complex findings in an accessible manner and adapt communication style to suit technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Apply strong analytical and problem solving skills to interpret test data uncover hidden issues and recommend practical improvements that enhance the overall user experience.
* Maintain a continuous learning mindset by staying updated on emerging tools practices and standards in quality engineering and applying them thoughtfully to existing solutions.
